techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol: DNS
techniques.description: Adversaries use the DNS protocol for command and control, blending malicious traffic with normal DNS resolution. Often paired with tunneling.

techniques.name: Protocol Tunneling
techniques.description: Adversaries tunnel another protocol's data inside DNS queries/responses to bypass network controls.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over Unencrypted Non-C2 Protocol
techniques.description: Data is exfiltrated over an unencrypted protocol such as DNS, encoding payload data in query names.

techniques.name: Network Service Discovery
techniques.description: Adversaries enumerate services and devices. SNMP walks/sweeps reveal device inventory and configuration.

techniques.name: Data from Configuration Repository: SNMP (MIB Dump)
techniques.description: Adversaries query SNMP MIBs to collect device configuration data.

techniques.name: Network Denial of Service: Reflection Amplification
techniques.description: Adversaries abuse SNMP (e.g. GetBulk) to reflect and amplify traffic toward a victim for denial of service.
